description: Defines a struct TestBufferWriterStruct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> and IOutputBuffer for buffer writing operations within the Orleans.Serialization.TestKit namespace.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the write position by the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> representing the current writable buffer space.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> representing the current writable buffer space.

methods.name: GetReadOnlySequence
methods.description: Returns a ReadOnlySequence<byte> over the written buffer segment, batching with the specified max segment size.
